worked_example.problem: Ngozi asks an AI tool to write her History homework and hands it in as her own. What is wrong?
steps: The work was not written by Ngozi.
Handing it in as her own is dishonest.
She also has not checked whether the facts are right.
worked_example.answer: It is dishonest, and the facts may be wrong.

cards.idea: AI is used in health, farming, transport, education, banking and translation.
example: An app can spot cassava disease from a photo of a leaf.

cards.idea: Be honest: do not hand in AI work as your own; check its facts.
example: Use AI to help you understand, then write your own answer.

cards.idea: Protect privacy: never share your full name, address, photos or passwords with AI tools.
example: Keep personal details out of your questions.

give it your full name and address

right.text: AI can help doctors read X-rays.
Deepfakes can make fake pictures and voices.

wrong.text: It is fine to hand in AI work as your own.
